I. IDENTIFY THE ZFP28 GENOMIC ARCHITECTURE
==========================================

1. Create the ZFP28 analysis directory
--------------------------------------

Create an independent working directory for the ZFP28 analysis.

.. code-block:: bash

   cd /Volumes/Expansion/project3/bat_HTF_genomic_analysis
   mkdir -p ANALYSES/ZFP28/{intermediate,results,scripts,sequences}
   cd ANALYSES/ZFP28


2. Create the ZFP28 host-exon probes
------------------------------------

Exons 1–6 are used as host-derived ZFP28 probes.

Create the host-probe FASTA.

.. code-block:: bash

   cat > sequences/ZFP28_host_exon_probes.fa <<'EOF'
   >ZFP28_exon1_match
   
   >ZFP28_exon2_match
   CTCTGCCTTGCAGCAACATTGCCCTTCCTCTGGAGAGGAGGCACAAGCAGGAGACAGCAGGGACAGGAAATGAACCCCAAGCCATGTCCCAG
   >ZFP28_exon3_match
   AGCTTGGTGACATTTGGGGATGTGGCTGTGGATTTCTCTCAGGAGGAGTGGGAACGGCTGAACTCTGACCAGAGGGACCTGTACAGGCGTGTGATGCTGGAGAACTACAGGAACCTGGTGTCGCTGG
   >ZFP28_exon4_match
   GACTTTGCTTCTCTAAGCCCGACTTAATCTCCTCATTGGAACAAAGGAAAGAGCTCTGGAAGGCCAAGAGAGAGGTGACCAGAGGCCAGTGTCCAG
   >ZFP28_exon5_match
   ACTGGAAGGCTGTGCCAGAGAGCGAGGAGTTATCTCCAAAGAAGGACTTGTGTAGAGAAGAGTTGTCCAAAGCCATGCTCATGGGCGGACTGACTGGCTACAGTTTGGGGTGCTCCATGCTAGGGGAACACTGGGATTATGAGGCTCTGTTTGCGAGGCAGCCG
   >ZFP28_exon6_match
   AGCTTGGTGACTATCTCGAATATGGCCATAGATTTCTCCCAGCGGCTAGACCCAGCTCAGAGGAGCTTCTGTAAGAATGTGATGTGGGAGAGCCACAACCTGGGGTCAGTAG
   EOF


3. Create the GOLEM-1p-derived probe
------------------------------------

Exon 7 corresponds to the TE-derived portion of the candidate transcript
and is therefore analyzed independently from the host-derived ZFP28 exons.

Create the TE probe.

.. code-block:: bash

   cat > sequences/ZFP28_GOLEM-1p_probe.fa <<'EOF'
   >GOLEM-1p_match
   
   EOF


4. Verify the probe sequences
-----------------------------

Check the host-exon headers.

.. code-block:: bash

   grep '^>' sequences/ZFP28_host_exon_probes.fa

Expected output::

   >ZFP28_exon1_match
   >ZFP28_exon2_match
   >ZFP28_exon3_match
   >ZFP28_exon4_match
   >ZFP28_exon5_match
   >ZFP28_exon6_match

Check the host-exon lengths.

.. code-block:: bash

   awk '
   /^>/ {
       if (name) print name, length(seq)
       name=$0
       seq=""
       next
   }
   {
       seq=seq $0
   }
   END {
       print name, length(seq)
   }
   ' sequences/ZFP28_host_exon_probes.fa

Expected lengths::

   >ZFP28_exon1_match 580
   >ZFP28_exon2_match 92
   >ZFP28_exon3_match 127
   >ZFP28_exon4_match 96
   >ZFP28_exon5_match 164
   >ZFP28_exon6_match 112

Check the TE-derived probe.

.. code-block:: bash

   awk '
   /^>/ {
       if (name) print name, length(seq)
       name=$0
       seq=""
       next
   }
   {
       seq=seq $0
   }
   END {
       print name, length(seq)
   }
   ' sequences/ZFP28_GOLEM-1p_probe.fa

Expected result::

   >GOLEM-1p_match 1896
